note: Commerce Promotion by amount adds two CommercePromotionOffer plugins - order_item_fixed_amount_off_by_amount and order_item_percentage_off_by_amount - that discount only the single cheapest or most expensive matching order item. There is no settings form, config schema, permissions or Drush; configuration lives entirely on a commerce_promotion entity's offer field (target_plugin_id + target_plugin_configuration with keys type=cheapest|most_expensive, compare=product|order_item, scope=order_item|product). Medium cases create a known promotion so the agent reads the offer config back; hard cases require the agent to build a promotion with the right offer plugin and type, verified against the live commerce_promotion entity. All cases are grounded in the real plugin ids and config keys.

evals.prompt: In the Drupal Commerce module commerce_promotion_by_amount, what are the machine ids of the two promotion offer plugins it provides, and what do they discount?
evals.expected_output: It provides two CommercePromotionOffer plugins: order_item_fixed_amount_off_by_amount (fixed amount off) and order_item_percentage_off_by_amount (percentage off). Each discounts only the single cheapest or most expensive matching order item in the order.

evals.prompt: When configuring a commerce_promotion_by_amount offer, which settings decide WHICH item gets discounted and HOW MUCH of it? Name the configuration keys and their possible values.
evals.expected_output: type = cheapest | most_expensive (which single item), compare = product | order_item (rank by unit price or order-item total), scope = order_item | product (discount all units of the item or only one unit).

evals.prompt: If a cart has several matching products, how many of them does a commerce_promotion_by_amount offer actually discount, and how is the target chosen?
evals.expected_output: Only one order item is discounted: the offer sorts all items by price and applies the discount to the first item (cheapest or most expensive per the type setting) that also passes the promotion's offer conditions; the adjustment is clamped so the item total never goes below zero.

evals.prompt: This site has a Commerce promotion named 'cpba_known' that uses a commerce_promotion_by_amount offer. Inspect the promotion entity and state which offer plugin it uses and whether it targets the cheapest or the most expensive item.
evals.expected_output: cpba_known uses the order_item_percentage_off_by_amount offer with target_plugin_configuration.type = most_expensive, so it discounts the most expensive matching item.

evals.prompt: There is a Commerce promotion named 'cpba_plugin' on this site. Inspect its offer and report the exact offer plugin id it uses and the value of its 'scope' setting.
evals.expected_output: cpba_plugin uses order_item_fixed_amount_off_by_amount with scope = product (discount only one unit of the chosen item).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, create an enabled commerce_promotion named exactly 'cpba_task' that uses the commerce_promotion_by_amount percentage offer to take 50% off the CHEAPEST matching product in the order. Use order type 'default' and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A commerce_promotion named cpba_task whose offer target_plugin_id is order_item_percentage_off_by_amount with target_plugin_configuration.type = cheapest (percentage 0.5).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal Commerce site, create an enabled commerce_promotion named exactly 'cpba_fixed' that uses the commerce_promotion_by_amount fixed-amount offer to take a flat amount off the MOST EXPENSIVE matching product in the order. Use order type 'default' and apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: A commerce_promotion named cpba_fixed whose offer target_plugin_id is order_item_fixed_amount_off_by_amount with target_plugin_configuration.type = most_expensive.
